summary: Task PRs open ready unless CodeQL runs on pull requests: shared detection for step 11, ship and mark-ready; openTaskPrsReady stays the explicit override (AISDLC-1149)

options.description: Detection means CodeQL runs on pull requests; step 11/ship/mark-ready share it and open ready when false; openTaskPrsReady kept as override and added to schema and docs; set true in this repo
Step 11 body emits 'draft until CodeQL is clean'; rejected: without Analyze checks mark-ready still never flips
Set governance.openTaskPrsReady true here and change no code; rejected: every adopter with scheduled-only CodeQL stays stuck and the key is not in the schema

body: 2026-11-01: PRs #2251-#2261 sat as drafts with no CI; draft PRs skip every gate job (AISDLC-218). mark-ready-after-codeql (DEC-0062) cannot flip them here: repoHasCodeql is true because codeql.yml exists, but DEC-0250 removed its pull_request trigger, so no Analyze check ever appears. The body phrase 'draft until CodeQL is clean' was never emitted by any template. Step 11 creates the PR after review and signing, so draft-on-open no longer avoids a second CI run; the merge gate (pr-ready + attestation) is unchanged, so this is not a trust-chain control. Class (a): reversible by config, small blast radius. Operator delegated the choice to the planner ('decision is yours'). Reverse by: set governance.openTaskPrsReady false and revert the step 11/ship default.
